relationships.subject: botulinum neurotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: the LC is freed from the remainder of the toxin and cleaves and deactivates soluble N-ethylmaleimide-sensitive factor attachment protein receptor (SNARE) proteins

relationships.subject: botulinum neurotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: BoNT-A inhibits the release of CGRP from rat trigeminal ganglia neurons (Durham et al., 2004)

relationships.subject: botulinum neurotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: a cutaneous injection of BoNT-A inhibits the upregulation of Nav1.7 in the trigeminal ganglia in a rat model of trigeminal neuropathic pain produced by malpositioned dental implants

relationships.subject: botulinum neurotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: Peripheral BoNT-A downregulated SNAP-25 and vesicular glutamate transporter 2 (VGluT2) in the dorsal horn of the spinal cord and reduced glutamate concentration in the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: botulinum neurotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: BoNT-A was found to reduce the expression of interleukin-1β and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) in synovial tissues

key_findings: Review: BoNT analgesia in neuropathic pain depends on TRPV1-expressing afferents and substance P/NK1 signaling, with retrograde transport to central terminals.
BoNT reduces release of CGRP, glutamate and substance P and the expression of pronociceptive genes such as Nav1.7 and TRPV1.
